title: Nokko
extract:
Release Date: October 15, 2025
Below the snowbound crust of Orb Vallis, thrives a vast subterranean undergrowth. Dwellers of the Deepmines slumber upon the fungal bedrock, where impending trouble awakens an ancient youth. Nurture this mycelial paradise where wild roots and tiny Sprodlings roam free, then frolic amongst the fungus as Nokko, the Sporespreader. Spring forth as a shrunken munchkin, regrow and rebound, until death blooms for foes who threaten our sporadic peace. Nokko sprouted in Update 40.0 (2025-10-15): The Vallis Undermind.
 Nokko is a mushroom Warframe that grows a tenacious fungal colony for support and battlefield control. His Passive reverts him to a small Sprodling that spawns speed-boosting spores to reach a previously placed mushroom to revive himself.  Stinkbrain periodically sheds  Viral damage and status while lulling enemies to  Sleep, while  Brightbonnet releases pulses that boost  Ability Strength and restores ally Energy.  Reroot has Nokko transform into a small Sprodling that is Invulnerable and restores Health and Shields over time while releasing spore pickups that heal and speed him up.  Sporespring releases a ballistic mushroom that deals deadly Critical  Toxin damage while bouncing off of enemies and other created mushrooms, causing Stinkbrain and Brightbonnet to pulse faster and extend their lifespans.

Acquisition
Nokko's main and component blueprints are acquired from Deepmines Bounties as an uncommon and rare drop. Access requires completion of The New War.
Alternatively Nokko's blueprints can be purchased from Nightcap in Fortuna with  Fergolyte from Deepmines Bounties. Each component blueprint requires 160 and the main blueprint requires 240, totaling 720 Fergolyte for the whole set. Players must be at Rank 4 - Gardener with Nightcap in order to purchase.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.

Crafting

Lore & History

Delivering  Fergolyte to The Prince will cause it to grow, which unlocks a vision that reveals Nightcap's history with  Nokko. In this vision, players control a Sprodling guided by the voices and images of characters and growing mushrooms stalks.
20 Fergolyte unlocks the Purple Stem Path, 40 for the Blue Stem Path, and 60 for the Green Stem Path, for a total of 120 Fergolyte.

Purple Stem Path
Nightcap is introduced willingly working for Nef Anyo, clearing out the native fungi that grow beneath the Vallis surface to make room for  Corpus expansion. Nightcap and his fellow Solaris are led to believe that the fungi are an  Orokin experiment gone awry. After some time, they discover a "kid" deep in the mines who regularly sabotages their equipment.

Blue Stem Path
Despite his antics, Nightcap grows attached to the "kid" and names him Nokko (short for "No Corporate", or "No Co"). Nightcap learns that the Vallis fungi feed off waste products generated by Venus's cooling towers: without them, Venus would quickly revert to its normal, scorching climate. Despite Nef Anyo's demands, Nightcap shuts down the elevator leading to the Deepmines.

Green Stem Path
Nightcap discovers that Nokko is part of the Vallis fungi, defending his home and by extension, the Vallis above. Disappointed by Nightcap's resistance, Nef Anyo sends Corpus troops to breach the elevator. Nightcap responds by blowing up the mineshaft, denying any access going to and from the Deepmines. Cut off from resources, Nightcap's condition worsens while Nokko chooses to remain by his side. Nightcap is last seen laying on a bed of fungi, bidding Nokko farewell.
Dialogue from Nightcap stating he is physically unable to leave and Nef Anyo being unable to find Nightcap's name in debt ledgers implies that Nightcap starved to death and was revived by Nokko to continue defending the Deepmines. However, Nightcap himself denies this, warning the Tenno that The Prince can play tricks with their mind.

Notes
Nokko's Signature  Arbucep can trigger  Stinkbrain and  Brightbonnet's empowered states when shot at. This occurs even if another Warframe is wielding his signature weapon.
 Nightcap has unique dialogue when spoken to as Nokko.

Trivia
Nokko is the 62nd unique Warframe to be released.
Nokko's name may be derived from a combination of Japanese kinoko (きのこ), which means "mushroom", and a shortening of no corporate, which is the basis for the canon name that Nightcap coined for him.
Some of the fungi species that have inspired Nokko's design and base coloration include the king trumpet, chanterelle, inky cap, oyster, chicken of the woods, and the mutated cordyceps from The Last of Us.
During development, the Sprodlings were internally referred to as "Nokko babies" or "Tiny Nokko" before they were given an official name, and had become an inside meme between the developers.
He was officially revealed in Devstream 189. Prior in TennoCon 2025, the Vallis Undermind was coined the Unannounced Fall 2025 Update, where Pablo Alonso alluded to Nokko being a "fun guy", which had a dual meaning for his fungi theme.
The Vallis Undermind's release date, October 15th, intentionally or otherwise, coincides with National Mushroom Day.
Nokko was envisioned to be  Yareli's little brother early in development. In-game, she appears in his Idle Animations, specifically his neutral Agile and single pistol Noble.
He also shares Yareli's locale on Venus in the Orb Vallis.
Nokko's mushrooms resemble several types of real world mushrooms, such as the False Morels ( Stinkbrain), Chanterelles ( Brightbonnet), Baby Bella ( Reroot's Sprodling), and Stinkhorns ( Sporespring).
He is the first Warframe to vocalize his own name, as a Sprodling he sings "Nokko Nokko Nokko!"
The mushroom caps growing on Nokko's body and his helmets have jiggle physics, causing them to flap and bounce around as he moves.
